source_notes: GGUF tensor_type_geometry now forwards canonical registry; census compares every frozen geometry against live reader and enumerates the wire map.
Declaration-only Qwen/MiniMax model_description loaders do not own tensor data; binding lives at actual HIP/CUDA upload, MiniMax PackReader and GLM Index.
H3 quant formats require authoritative U8 JSON config; EXL3 needs checked companions and mul1 marker or explicit legacy fixed-codebook graph contract.
Tensor IDs use pack-relative shard namespace plus bounded container-header SHA256 and tensor name; file Source full content SHA256 remains lazy and guards cache identity.
